newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips sluggish, Nasdaq buoyant.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips sluggish, Nasdaq buoyant.

text.p: The Dow industrials moved off opening lows but remained somewhat soft in opening trade on Tuesday, hampered by a higher interest rate environment, but the Nasdaq composite continued to push higher.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was off 13 points at 8,186, while the long bond was off slightly, trading down 2/32 at a 6.48 percent yield.

"Stocks like a decent economy," Pierre Ellis, senior economist at Primark Decision Economics said. "Now that long term interest rates have backed up, it will dampen some of the enthusiasm in the stock market."
